kind: Offline implementation review evidence; synthetic transaction mechanics, not real PostgreSQL race acceptance
scope: Four existing implementation/registration files, additive migration036, two necessary tests and verification evidence only

implementation.association: agent_document_operations stores run/child/owner/op/tool only; no body. Scoped composite FK to both original run and document operation, with duplicate protection and parent cascades.
implementation.atomicity: writeDocument uses its original outer transaction and nested document savepoint. Receipt child checked before and after association; relation insert and run dataVersion update are part of the same commit.
implementation.read_port: documentReceipts returns explicit {receipts, unavailable, linked}. Its eight-tool bound includes a ninth-row overflow sentinel and fails closed; no partial overflow success.
implementation.read_authority: New linked runs recheck current child/workspace access, original run authVersion, epoch, original owner-authored message, current document and source validity. Expiry permits only reads of existing committed effects. The outer UPDATE authority lock matches nested document reads.
implementation.projection: Only existing schema tool references are added. Internal opId and savedVersion are never portrayed as a newly available wire field or latest document version. Original completed text/summary is blocked before finish if any linked receipt is invalid. Query errors use unknown rather than successful empty output.
implementation.recovery: get rebuilds references from the durable original run association after crash-before-finish/expiry; no new runtime or mutation. Non-completed status/stopReason is preserved when source validity fails.
implementation.identity: Both ordinary return and duplicate-message get recheck isCurrentUser after reading.
implementation.legacy: Zero new association rows retain original get access and historical projection. This delivery does not add source validation to legacy historical text.

typecheck.scope: Two new tests and imported dependency graph; not full repository.

synthetic_store_invariants: Rollback on linkage failure, later run advance failure or receipt-child mismatch
Original op replay performs no new document write/version or changeSeq increment
Expiry blocks new mutations but permits authorized committed reads
New store after crash-before-finish retrieves original unknown/interrupted run and minimal committed reference
Cross user/child/authVersion/epoch/source-message denial exposes no document receipt
Deleted document or invalid source clears new linked references and derived text
Legacy zero-link result remains unchanged under original access rules
Query error and >8 associations become unknown with no document reference or replay

preserved_failure_history.cause: New fixture used exports option absent from locked Node types; root-approved namedExports alias fixed it.
Snapshot initialization client lacked query needed by transactionPool.bind; replaced with a no-query initializer that throws on unexpected SQL.
Static DELETE-word assertion misclassified approved ON DELETE CASCADE; root-approved statement-level check corrected the test.

baseline_characterization: Historical baseline 2/2 and absent saved-document reporting are preserved separately; they are not the final implementation acceptance assertions.

environment.warning: namedExports is runtime-deprecated but supported; used because locked @types/node exposes that alias. No dependency change.

external_actions: No push, PR, merge, deployment or new cloud task. Root review and any true PostgreSQL acceptance remain separate.
